An '''avedame fruit'''<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|142|Jasserak Highlands}}</ref> was produced by a fungus-like [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew on the [[Jasserak Highlands]]. The [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] was used to distill [[avedame]] [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]].<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>
